semantics_note: A green 'Affected-version verification' check means the 0.3.15 defect was reproduced and verified exactly. It does not mean correct JSONC behaviour already works in the shipped package; the raw post-fix regression is deliberately kept failing and is only exercised by the manual workflow.
self_reference_note: Each documentation or evidence commit re-triggers these workflows by design, so the newest head's own runs are always produced after the index that cites them. PR #2's live check rollup is authoritative for any head newer than the snapshots recorded here.

macos_acquisition_history.summary: Three successive heads had the macOS scope job cancelled before executing any step. Every cancellation reported runner_id 0 with zero steps, and GitHub's own annotations attribute it to hosted capacity, so none was a defect, test, or platform-behaviour failure. In each of those runs the other seven jobs succeeded.
